text:
Dylan Cozens is the Senator whose numbers haven't caught up with his team. Ottawa has won three straight and is a strong bet for the playoffs in our simulations, yet Cozens has 12 points in 22 games, and the Senators have been outchanced when he's on at five on five (49% of the expected goals, six points worse than without him).

Some of that is luck. Ottawa has scored 4.6 fewer goals than its chances with him out there, and he's shooting 8.9% against the 13% we'd expect, so our range has his scoring rate climbing. The bigger change is his own chances, down to 0.90 expected goals per 60 from 1.29 last season, with his ice time down a minute over the last ten.

He was much better than this a year ago. Evolving-Hockey had him worth 2.0 wins in 2025-26, mostly from defense, taking chances away at a 98th-percentile rate. With William Eklund hurt, Tim Stützle has moved onto his line with Fabian Zetterlund. If anything gets his game going again, a center like that beside him should.
